scope: Bounded static review of pinned source contracts, not execution or independent replication of dataset/leaderboard claims

contracts.upstream: JSON Schema controls scalar/object/object-array structure and evaluation-side identity hints; alternate acceptable evidence readings and optional grounding.
contracts.invoice_example: A fixed five-field and complete line-record contract over source-qualified synthetic invoices; no bounding-box grounding claim.
contracts.decision: Reuse schema-guided public tasks when the document and decision fit. This example is not a missing-capability claim about ExtractBench.

contracts.upstream: Pinned unified metric recurses by schema, canonicalizes dates/whitespace and accepts declared alternate evidence values. Omitted fields use a schema default when present; otherwise missing is distinct from explicit null.
contracts.invoice_example: Exact Decimal/sign/currency/role values, explicit date normalization and whitespace/NFKC normalization; vendor and description casefold. No semantic judge or fuzzy assignment.
contracts.decision: Declare normalization and omission semantics for the operational task; metric names alone do not establish equivalence.

contracts.upstream: Global one-to-one Hungarian matching scores accepted cells and penalizes unmatched or surplus records. Nested object arrays can be aligned recursively.
contracts.invoice_example: Multiset complete-record equality preserves duplicate counts and requires all applicable roles together; whole-document task success additionally requires all fields and no missing/extra records.
contracts.decision: Use upstream assignment and partial-credit metrics where they fit. A complete-invoice acceptance criterion can be reported alongside them; no new generic matching framework is needed.

contracts.upstream: Evaluation runner synthesizes zero-scored missing attempts and pads genuine failures in applicable bounded macro metrics; unrelated product types are excluded by applicability.
contracts.invoice_example: Parser failures/empty/timeouts receive zero task credit on fixed eligible denominators; required evaluator failure invalidates the affected aggregate.
contracts.decision: Keep failed attempts and evaluator errors separately inspectable. Do not silently average only successes.

documentation_disagreement.finding: The pinned README describes omitted keys as implicit null. The unified evidence implementation explicitly distinguishes missing from null unless a schema default applies. The legacy array_record metric retains implicit-null behavior.
documentation_disagreement.interpretation: Pin the actual selected metric implementation before adopting its semantics; this is a static contract discrepancy, not a demonstrated leaderboard error.

conclusion: Evaluate ParseBench for parsing and ExtractBench for schema-guided extraction before constructing internal tasks. Extend only for a consequential workload/task mismatch. PDF-Bench contributes an inspectable benchmark-construction example and historical lessons; it does not establish a general coverage deficit in either public benchmark.
